subject: BASECONVERT function
notes: UPHELD after INDEPENDENT re-verification rather than by accepting the prior report. PRINTED PAGE RE-RENDERED AND READ (python scripts/render-spec-page.py 851 = printed folio 821): the format is 'FUNCTION BASECONVERT ( argument-1 argument-2 argument-3 )' with separate underline rules under FUNCTION and under BASECONVERT and none under the parentheses or the arguments -- exactly three arguments, no brackets, no braces, no choice indicators, no ellipsis, so nothing is optional and nothing is repeatable. specs/ISO_COBOL.md:30184 now carries the matching <u>FUNCTION</u> <u>BASECONVERT</u> markup, so the transcription is faithful and the earlier reconciliation defect is repaired. GRAMMAR READ, NOT INFERRED: BASECONVERT is not a lexer token anywhere under src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Grammar/, so it arrives through `functionName : IDENTIFIER` and the generic `functionCall : FUNCTION functionName (LPAREN functionArgList? RPAREN)?`, with `functionArgList : functionArgument (FNARG_SEPARATOR? functionArgument)*`. Acceptance AND rejection re-run in both directions: BASECONVERT("FF" 16 10) (the printed juxtaposition form) -> 255; BASECONVERT("FF", 16, 10) (the §8.3.5 comma separator) -> 255; lowercase 'function baseconvert(...)' -> 255; argument-2/argument-3 as PIC 99 DATA ITEMS -> 255; as a DISPLAY operand and nested inside another BASECONVERT -> correct. Arity is enforced by BindIntrinsicCore against the IntrinsicCatalog Fixed 3,3 row: 2 arguments, 4 arguments and the bare 'FUNCTION BASECONVERT' with no parentheses each draw 'error COBOL1504: FUNCTION BASECONVERT takes 3 argument(s); N given (ISO 15.3)', and BASECONVERT(OMITTED, 16, 10) draws COBOL1544 per §8.4.3.2 SR7. EDITION taken from Annex E.3.3 item 22, NOT from the catalog row, and confirmed at the CLI: --std 85 / 2002 / 2014 each reject with COBOL1502 naming 2023. COVERING TEST verified on disk: tests/conformance/2023/intrinsics_string_2023.cob writes the three-argument format three times against tests/conformance/2023/intrinsics_string_2023.out, whose BASECONVERT lines (DEC=255, HEX=FF, BIN=A) I recomputed by hand from §15.12.4 -- spec-derived, not a legacy or GnuCOBOL comparison. ADJACENT, outside this rule's text and NOT counted against it: reference modification of the function result, FUNCTION BASECONVERT("FF", 16, 10)(1:2), is a PARSE ERROR ('COBOL0001: no viable alternative at input (') although §8.4.3.3.4 SR2 says 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function' -- an §8.4.3.3.4 grammar gap affecting every alphanumeric intrinsic, for whoever adjudicates that clause.
